resources.string: No server address has been set yet.
Tried %1$s but got no response.\n\nCheck that the backend is running and that this device is on the same network.
Enter the address of your OpenFic backend. All data stays on your own server.
For example 192.168.1.10:8000, nas.local:8000 or https://openfic.example.com. http:// is assumed when no scheme is given.

Uses the interface packaged in the app: faster startup, and it still works when the backend does not serve the frontend. Note: if the backend requires a password, cross-origin cookies may prevent sign-in.
Loads the interface served by your backend, fully same-origin. It follows backend updates automatically and signs in correctly when a password is set.
The address must start with http:// or https://.
